data.title: Sobha Solis
data.about:
Sobha Solis at Motor City is a premium residential project by Sobha Group, featuring an exquisite selection of 1, 1.5, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments providing breathtaking views. This exceptional development is designed to offer a modern, luxurious lifestyle with four iconic towers standing on a shared podium, creating a blend of privacy and community living. The luxurious lifestyle extends to the viewing decks that offer panoramic views of Dubai Autodrome.

Situated in the vibrant Dubai Motor City, Sobha Solis provides easy access to key areas of the city, thanks to its proximity to major roads like Al Qudra and Hessa Street. This location strikes the perfect balance between urban convenience and a peaceful residential environment, with nearby attractions such as Dubai Autodrome and First Avenue Mall offering endless leisure, shopping, and dining options.

characteristics_module.title: Unrivaled Amenities for an Action-Packed Lifestyle!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Spacious Units: Premium 1, 1.5, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with large windows and balconies for stunning views.
  • Ideal Location: Strategically located, Sobha Solis by Sobha Realty in Motor City offers easy access to major destinations.
  • Arsenal Fitness Zone: Push your limits at the Arsenal Fitness Zone, featuring cutting-edge equipment inspired by elite athletes for a workout experience like no other.
  • Views of the Track: Panoramic views of Dubai Autodrome are available from exclusive viewing decks.
  • Versatile Shared Spaces: Whether relaxing in cozy seating courts, enjoying an outdoor cinema, or letting the kids explore the pool and play area, Sobha Solis offers something for every lifestyle.
  • Co-Working and Creative Spaces: Stay productive with access to modern co-working spaces and a curated library designed to inspire focus and creativity.
  • Wellness and Recreation: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with Zen gardens, jogging paths, and a dedicated dog park, offering tranquillity and outdoor enjoyment.
  • Family-Centered Amenities: From children’s play areas to a vibrant social scene, Sobha Solis ensures a balanced, enriching environment for residents of all ages.

location_tile.title: Where Urban Comfort Meets Thrilling Adventure
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Sobha Solis is located in Dubai Motor City, a thriving hub known for its motorsport attractions and family-friendly environment. Residents enjoy the perfect blend of modern conveniences and natural beauty, with access to world-class amenities and iconic landmarks just minutes away. 
Surrounded by lush green spaces, premier shopping venues, and dining options, Sobha Solis offers a dynamic lifestyle. Whether you're seeking an active, adventure-filled day or a peaceful evening at home, Sobha Solis provides the best of both worlds in a vibrant community setting.

Dubai Marina - 16 Minutes
Downtown Dubai - 30 Minutes
Palm Jumeirah - 15 Minutes
Riverland Dubai - 15 Minutes
